This beta moves to the Payload 4 beta and its file versions. Install it with Payload `4.0.0-beta.1`. It has breaking changes: follow the [upgrade guide](https://payload-storage-bunny.seshuk.im/v4/upgrade-guide#v400-beta1-to-v400-beta2) before you deploy.

### ⚠️ Before you upgrade

- Requires Payload `4.0.0-beta.0` or later and Next.js `>=16.4 <17`. Canary builds are not supported.
- Run Payload's `sizes-to-variants` migration first. SQL databases then need one more migration for the new columns.
- `tus-auth` creates the TUS upload itself. Custom TUS clients send `PATCH` requests to the returned `uploadUrl`.
- The Stream webhook writes the encoding status straight to the database, so collection hooks no longer run for it.
- Rename and restore point the new file to the same Stream video. The video is deleted only when no document or version uses it.
- Collections on the same Stream library need the same `cleanup` setting, or the plugin throws at startup.
- Redeploy the Edge Script if you use client uploads over the HTTP API.
